x: We had great hopes however, of a placing with Stan Vickers, and Eric Hall, Kent and Surrey Champions, Syd James 2nd in the Surrey, George Checkley 5th in the Middlesex and Bob McMullen back from Canada and showing something like his old form, together with George Beecham, young Terry Clark and Ted Smith.

Our lads showed steady improvement and we were glad to see Dave McMullen and Syd James to the fore. Ted Smith was our first man home in (10th) followed by McMullen, Checkley and Newson, 12th, 15th and 16th.
Ted Smith,showing his true form,was 4th,Syd James 12th, Checkley 5th.McMullen 7th and Newson 13th.After this we can hope to regain the Berman Cup in our own Open on Nov24th.
McMullen, Hyde, Pope, Scammell, Green, Fletcher and Holland were the most prominent. Our 'A' team packed in fine fashion to win the scratch team race (3,6,7,9).
Thames’ Huw Lobb gunned it from the start and with their next man, McMullen, occupying second spot had a great start in their efforts to keep Herne Hill at bay.
Major and McMullen pushed hard for Thames on the first circuit but Ben Whitby was only biding his time and he came away for a clear Herne Hill individual victory.
